summary: Admidio is a self-hosted user management platform designed for clubs, associations, and community groups. It provides a structured environment to handle member databases, assign granular permissions, and mirror the hierarchical roles of an organisation.
goodFor: Voluntary associations and community groups requiring a dedicated tool to manage memberships and internal access rights without relying on proprietary SaaS platforms.
watchOut: The project has a modest community footprint, meaning you may need to rely on the existing documentation and forums if you encounter specific configuration issues.
deployNotes: As a PHP application deployed via Docker, you will typically need to configure a persistent volume for uploaded files and user data, alongside a separate database container and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
